Name: Junimo Glades - Buildable greenhouse
Author: Sharogg
Description:
A magical door in a large tree teleports you to the Junimo glade, where through Junimo magic you can grow whatever you want no matter the season. The Junimos protect your crops from weeds, weather and crows.

This is a magical building acting like a greenhouse that can be purchased at the wizards' for endgame costs, since it offers a lot of growing space on a very small footprint. Ideal if you like the feel of a tiny farm but don't want to miss out on the crop space. Grass will spread as well if you need extra for your animals. Or make it into a honey farm with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10996]Better Beehouses[/url].

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Works like a greenhouse
[*]Crop space for at least 12 iridium sprinklers with pressure nozzles
[*]grass, natural dirt patches or predetermined crop layout according to preference
[*]optional decorations
[*]seasonal appearance - or pick the season you like the most and it stays that way
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]
The map has recolour compatibility with everything, the building texture is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolour[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]VPR[/url].

[b]Installation[/b]
Unzip the mod and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder. Requires SMAPI, Content Patcher and DaisyNiko's Tilesheets. 1.6. is required.
